title: Perturbed Dyadic Cubes and Quantitative Estimates for Schrödinger Operators with Potentials in $RH^{n/2}$
summary: Let $L:=-Δ+V$ be a Schrödinger operator on the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$ with potential $V$ in the reverse Hölder class $RH^{n/2}$ satisfying some mild assumptions that $V$ neither decays too rapidly nor oscillates violently at infinity. In this paper, the authors construct a new system of dyadic cubes $\mathcal{D}^V$ that reflects the intrinsic geometry perturbed by $V$. Then using the quantitative geometric information of $\mathcal{D}^V$, the authors characterize the $L^p$ operator norm of the Riesz potential $L^{-α/2}$ for all $α\in (0,2]$ and $p\in (1,\infty)$.
